headline: Italy October Inflation Rises to 5.4% as Q3 GDP Stagnates
summary: Italy's annual inflation rate rose to 5.4% in October, driven by a more than 31% surge in energy costs, while gross domestic product showed no growth in the third quarter.
why: Stagnant GDP growth combined with accelerating inflation points toward stagflationary pressures in the eurozone's third-largest economy, complicating monetary policy decisions for the European Central Bank.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Persistent inflation alongside stagnant economic growth in major eurozone economies weakens regional currency prospects.
